requires: An M-VAVE FM-1 running stock V15 or official fm1_open firmware. If it runs stock V15, this page installs official Open first
Chrome or Edge on a computer, with MIDI and SysEx allowed
Anything you want to keep backed up. On official Open, M-VAVE's workbench backs up projects, samples and voices. Stock V15 has no project library for it to read

notes: CLATTER Pocket 1.0 is hardware verified on one FM-1: installed over another firmware and from stock V15, left for V15 and installed again, and it reports its own identity, FM-1_8133700. The report: https://github.com/clickysteve/clatter-pocket/issues/2, and the full test of the same firmware as 0.9.4: https://github.com/clickysteve/clatter-pocket/issues/1.

On PATTERN, hold SEQ and press REC to clear the pattern; SAVE+OCT− undoes it. Hold SEQ with OCT− to copy a page and OCT+ to paste it. Projects have 8-letter names, and GLOBAL's playing settings survive a power-off.
Builds before 1.0 reported official Open's identity, FM-1_8000014. Installing 1.0 over them, or over official Open, works as before.
One unit, so not every case is covered. Untested on a device: Bluetooth MIDI and audio, DIN and TRS MIDI, SAFE MODE, and runs longer than a test session.
If an FM-1 is restarting at the start-up screen: power on holding HOME until SAFE MODE shows, then connect the installer. This has not been tried on a device.
